yt_title: What Is Inside A Baseball? 108 Stitches Explained #Shorts
desc: A baseball has a cork centre, wrapped wool yarn and a cowhide cover held on by 108 double stitches. The wooden bat that hits it is capped at about two and a half inches thick. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: Would you guess a baseball hides cork inside? ⚾ Follow for a fact every day. Save this! Comment CORK or WOOL

lines.text: What is really inside a baseball? Not what you think.
At the centre sits a small ball of cork and rubber.
Wool yarn is wrapped around it, then covered in cowhide.
The skin is held on by exactly one hundred eight double stitches.
The bat is wood, usually ash or maple. So what is the pro bat limit?
